EDGE_PORT_CMP_B11G3338N81D_1_TIM_HEAT_OU.resolution_note: Assumption: Lee/Song/Au/Moran disc spreading, exact series, with Bi → ∞ (a perfectly cooled far face). Bi needs h, which is a Screen 06 boundary condition, and Bi → ∞ gives the smallest spreading the model can produce — so this UNDER-estimates. Screen 07 re-solves this edge at the finite Bi the scenario's own boundary implies and reports both numbers; the value here is the floor. The series itself is exact for the stated geometry; the equal-area circular substitution for a rectangular base costs under ~10%.
